definition: אַלּוֺן noun masculine Gen 35:8 oak ( ᵐ5 βάλανος , δρῦς , etc.) — ׳ א absolute Gen 35:8 +; construct ib. ; plural אַלּוֺנִים Amos 2:9 ; Ezek 27:6 construct אַלּוֺנֵי Isa 2:13 ; Zech 11:12 — as marking grave of Deborah, Rebekah's nurse Gen 35:8 ( E ); whence called oak of weeping , בָּכוּת ׳ א ib. (see Di on the passage , & below אֵלוֺן p. 18); elsewhere only in prophets; as marking illicit shrines Hos 4:13 (|| לִבְנֶה , אֵלָה ); as felled Isa 6:13 (in simile; || אֵלָה ); as furnishing material for making idols Isa 44:14 (|| אֶרֶז , תִּרְזָה , אֹרֶן ); as simile for strength ( חסן ) Amos 2:9 also אַלּוֺנֵי הַבָּשָׁן Isa 2:13 (as lofty & majestic), compare Ezek 27:6 (as strong, for making oars); Zech 11:2 , metaphor of prominent men.
